text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon, I see you are deeply troubled!
Tell this
genius what troubles you!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, I am not troubled. I was simply
running a
simulation.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
My classmates have deemed my actions
to be
"too much." So I am calculating
how to fix that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! "Too much"?! And you're quite
sure that's
what they said?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems their assessment is based
on my
training load and my everyday
behavior.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then there's no problem at all! People
tell me I'm
too much all the time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
This just means you're a genius... just like
me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's right! So wear that "too much"
label with
pride! It is proof of your
greatness!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Accessing data storage. Reclassifying
"too
much" as a compliment. Thank you
for your help.
